payload.title: Explain 'pre-registered' where it appears
payload.description: Readers see 'pre-registered' on dimension and question pages without an explanation. Add a short inline definition (accessible tooltip or expandable note) and a methods-page section: before an engine answered anything, each prediction (direction and rough size) was committed to the public repository, so the commit date proves it came first; the page then shows prediction, observed result and verdict. Link each prediction's commit. Distinguish pre-registered questions from exploratory ones.
